content.text:
The test passes. Let me summarize the change I made.

I implemented "just the open tasks / just the finished ones" as a full-stack, additive filter:

**Server** (`TasksGetLogic.java`): added an optional `status` query parameter (`ALL`/`OPEN`/`DONE`) to `GET /api/tasks`. Absent/unknown → all tasks; `OPEN` → not done; `DONE` → done.

**Data access** (`TaskRepository.java`): added `findByProjectAndDone(projectId, done)` alongside the existing `findByProject`.

**Front-end** (`ProjectTasks.tsx`): added a `data-testid="task-filter"` `<select>` (All/Open/Done, default All) that refetches on change, and made toggling reload so a ticked-off task correctly drops in/out of the active filter.

No schema migration or new seed capability was needed — the `tasks` table and its `done` seed support already exist, and this feature only reads them. All existing `data-testid` anchors were preserved.
